display.purpose: Every heading (h1-h3), client-pinned and the real modern-SaaS default.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hero screenshot, featured pricing card, contact dialog.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Cards rise into place on scroll. Transform-only — opacity is never the gating property, so content never goes invisible if the observer misses.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one yellow pill CTA, repeated across header/hero/sections.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FECC01; color: #111111; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.9rem 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(17,17,17,.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Icon-badge + heading + text, the recurring feature-grid unit.

components.css: .ds-tier { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 20px; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(17,17,17,.06); } .ds-tier--featured { border-color: #FECC01; border-width: 2px; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -16px rgba(17,17,17,.22); } .ds-tier-tag { background: #111111; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-tier-cta { width: 100%; background: #111111; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: This is not a rolled distinctive direction — the client explicitly asked for modern SaaS and named the craft bar directly: Toast POS, Square, Lightspeed. The job is executing that canon at full fidelity: rounded product-screenshot cards with soft lifted shadows, generous corner radii, icon-badge feature grids, warm real photography, bold pill CTAs, a logo trust bar under the hero. Two other worlds were built and explicitly rejected earlier — a cork-noticeboard 'Bacheca' and an editorial 'Il Menu del Giorno' — both are now anti-reference only.
keyCharacteristics: White/off-white ground, yellow as the one confident accent (never a background fill).
Rounded system: 8px small controls, 12px cards/inputs, 20px large frames, full pill CTAs.
Icon-badge feature grids and a real product screenshot in the hero — earned by the named canon.
One motion grammar: transform-only rise on scroll, opacity never gates content.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Yellow never covers a section background; it fills small specific shapes only.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits directly above a heading as an eyebrow; role/category tags go inline beside it.

rules.name: The Floating Screenshot Rule
rules.body: Anything presented as 'the product' gets the Lifted shadow.

dos: Do keep reveal motion transform-only, never opacity-gated.
Do reuse the icon-badge motif across every card type.
Do use real photography wherever the layout can carry it.
Do keep pricing honest — 'Prezzo su richiesta' until real figures exist.
donts: Don't place a role/category label directly above a heading.
Don't let yellow cover a section background.
Don't invent usage stats or customer counts.
Don't revert to Bacheca or Il Menu del Giorno without a new explicit client direction.
